treatment_summary.value: Prednisolone, which relieved the clinical symptoms and normalized CRP levels.

disease_label_as_stated.value: Juvenile onset autoinflammatory disease due to a novel mutation in TNFAIP3 (A20); autoinflammatory phenotype resembling Behçet's disease

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Features resembling HA20 (periodic fever, oral ulcers, elevated serum pro-inflammatory cytokines TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, IL-8) prompted TNFAIP3 gene analysis; heterozygous mutation confirmed by Sanger sequencing; reduced A20 protein expression in PBMCs. HLA-B haplotype was not B51 (B39/B62).
Similar symptoms to the proband; the heterozygous C200A fs*16 mutation was found by Sanger sequencing.
Sanger sequencing showed no variant of TNFAIP3; described as unaffected/healthy.

parental_testing_statement.value: Sanger sequencing of the unaffected father showed no variant of TNFAIP3, suggesting that these mutations were maternally derived (the mother had died of septicaemia 2 years prior; no genotype reported for her).

functional_evidence_statement.value: Immunoblot of patient PBMCs vs a healthy control: reduced wild-type A20 protein expression at baseline and after TNF-α stimulation (10 ng/ml, 24 h); cytosolic IκB-α reduced after TNF-α stimulation in patient PBMCs but unchanged in control PBMCs, suggesting accelerated IκB-α degradation.

parental_testing_statement.value: Sanger sequencing of the unaffected father showed no variant of TNFAIP3, suggesting that these mutations were maternally derived (no genotype reported for the deceased mother).
